lines.translation: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.
I have enshrined the Naam, the One Name, within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam japee tai naam dhiaaee mahal paai gun gaahaa he ||11||
lines.translation: I chant the Naam, and meditate on the Naam. Singing His Glorious Praises, I enter the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||11||
The servant serves, and obeys the Command of the Infinite Lord.
The self-willed manmukhs do not know the value of the Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: hukame ma(n)ne hukame vadiaaee hukame veparavaahaa he ||12||
lines.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one is exalted; by His Hukam, one is glorified; by His Hukam, one becomes carefree. ||12||
By Guru's Grace, one recognizes the Lord's Hukam.
The wandering mind is restrained, and brought back to the home of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naame raataa sadaa bairaagee naam ratan man taahaa he ||13||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Naam, one remains forever detached; the jewel of the Naam rests within the mind. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag mahi varatai eko soee ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is pervasive throughout all the world.
By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabad salaahahi se jan niramal nij ghar vaasaa taahaa he ||14||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who praise the Shabad are immaculate; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||14||
The devotees abide forever in Your Sanctuary, Lord.
You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your value cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: jiu tudh bhaavahi tiu too raakhahi guramukh naam dhiaahaa he ||15||
lines.translation: As it pleases Your Will, You keep us; the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam. ||15||
Forever and ever, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
O my True Lord and Master, may I become pleasing to Your Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee sach devahu sach samaahaa he ||16||1||10||
lines.translation: Nanak offers this true prayer: O Lord, please bless me with Truth, that I may merge in the Truth. ||16||1||10||
Maaroo, Third Mehl:
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukhadaataa raviaa ghat a(n)tar sabad sachai omaahaa he ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever deep within their hearts; they delight in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
When the Lord grants His Grace, one meets with the Guru.
The Name of the Lord is enshrined within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har man vasiaa sadaa sukhadaataa sabade man omaahaa he ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever within the mind; the mind is delighted with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He unites in His Union.
Egotism and attachment are burned away by the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa mukat rahai ik ra(n)gee naahee kisai naal kaahaa he ||3||
lines.translation: In the Love of the One Lord, one remains liberated forever; he is not in conflict with anyone. ||3||
Without serving the True Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai koi na paavai paaraa ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, no one crosses over to the other side.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jo sabad raate mahaa bairaagee so sach sabade laahaa he ||4||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Shabad, are very detached. They earn the profit of the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh karatai dhur likh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Pain and pleasure are pre-ordained by the Creator.
He Himself has caused the love of duality to be pervasive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s alipato varatai manamukh kaa kiaa vesaahaa he ||5||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh remains detached; how can anyone trust the self-willed manmukh? ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: se manamukh jo sabad na pachhaanahi ||
lines.translation: Those who do not recognize the Shabad are manmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke bhai kee saar na jaanahi ||
lines.translation: They do not know the essence of the Fear of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਮੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏਗਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bin kiu nirabhau sach paaeeai jam kaadh laegaa saahaa he ||6||
lines.translation: Without this Fear, how can anyone find the Fearless True Lord? The Messenger of Death will pull the breath out. ||6||
The invulnerable Messenger of Death cannot be killed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabade neR na aaee ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad prevents him from approaching.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਤਾ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਭਾਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sabad sune taa doorahu bhaagai mat maare har jeeu veparavaahaa he ||7||
lines.translation: When he hears the Word of the Shabad, he runs far away. He is afraid that the self-sufficient Dear Lord will kill him. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਸਿਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu kee hai sabh sirakaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord is the Ruler above all.
What can this wretched Messenger of Death do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਢਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: hukamee ba(n)daa hukam kamaavai hukame kadhadaa saahaa he ||8||
lines.translation: As slave to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal acts according to His Hukam. According to His Hukam, he is deprived of his breath. ||8||
The Gurmukh realizes that the True Lord created the creation.
The Gurmukh knows that the Lord has expanded the entire expanse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai so sach boojhai sabad sachai sukh taahaa he ||9||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands the True Lord. Through the True Word of the Shabad, he finds peace. ||9||
The Gurmukh knows that the Lord is the Architect of karma.
